content.user_title: Review Revnu Growth Results and Pending Approvals
content.value_statement: Growth activity alone does not show business outcomes or explain missing data. This skill uses connected Revnu evidence to report results, reporting periods, and pending approvals.
actual_capabilities: Read available email, outbound, LinkedIn, advertising, SEO, and AI visibility metrics through Revnu reporting tools.
Request read-only CRM and pipeline reports, track completion, and check returned sources and record identifiers.
Identify reporting windows and distinguish unavailable data from measured zero results.
Inspect pending drafts, questions, and budgets through review tools without approving them.
Read agent activity, recurring workflow schedules, run outcomes, and leads associated with a workflow run.
Separate activity, replies, meetings, conversions, and revenue when summarizing performance.
limitations: Requires connected Revnu tools and authorized account access; this skill does not include their implementation.
The channel scoreboard defaults to 24 hours and reaches back at most 31 days; longer reports require a separate request.
Available metrics depend on connected sources, tracking settings, and channel-specific reporting windows.
Does not build dashboards, report engineering status, send outreach, publish content, approve budgets, or start growth work.

use_cases.title: Prepare a founder growth update
use_cases.description: Review recent outcomes, shipped work, reporting gaps, and items awaiting approval using connected account evidence.

use_cases.title: Assess channel performance
use_cases.description: Compare available campaign and outreach metrics while keeping spend, activity, replies, and conversions distinct.

use_cases.title: Review CRM pipeline progress
use_cases.description: Request a read-only report for a named CRM, validate source records, and disclose unsupported connections or missing evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Check recent results
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Revnu growth results for the last 24 hours. State the actual reporting window and identify unavailable channels.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: get a recent account summary.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect pending approvals
prompt_templates.prompt: Show what is waiting for my approval in Revnu and summarize each item. Do not approve, send, publish, or spend anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review the approval queue without taking action.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate outbound performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review outbound results for the last seven days. Separate delivery, replies, bounces, and business outcomes. Calculate rates only when populations match.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assess outreach using comparable evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile CRM and channel reports
prompt_templates.prompt: Request a read-only pipeline report from [CRM] for [period]. Verify sources and record identifiers. Cross-check channel figures against matching scoreboard windows.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine CRM evidence with channel reporting.

output_examples.input: Summarize growth performance from this sample: 120 sends, 9 replies, and an unavailable advertising connection.
output: Illustrative report: the returned window covers the last 24 hours.
Email recorded 120 sends and 9 replies; a reply rate requires confirmation that both counts cover the same recipients.
Advertising performance is unknown because the connection is unavailable, not because spend or conversions were zero.
These figures show activity and replies, not confirmed meetings or revenue.

output_examples.input: Show an example approval summary when the account returns one draft and one budget question.
output: Illustrative review: two items are waiting for your attention, one draft and one budget question.
No items were approved, and no outreach, publishing, or spending was started.
The queue alone does not establish whether scheduled growth work is complete.

best_practices: Name the actual returned window and retain channel-specific periods when comparing results.
Verify CRM sources and record identifiers, and cross-check channel figures for matching windows.
Keep reporting requests read-only and distinguish missing evidence from measured zero results.
anti_patterns: Presenting disconnected or unavailable channels as zero performance.
Treating replies, clicks, or opens as confirmed meetings, customers, or revenue.
Using reporting requests to approve budgets, send messages, publish content, or start new work.

faq.question: Do I need a connected Revnu account?
faq.answer: Yes. Reporting requires authorized Revnu tools and supported account connections. If disconnected, results remain unknown until setup and evidence retrieval succeed.

faq.question: Can this skill change records or send outreach?
faq.answer: The instructions require read-only reports and explicitly prohibit starting outreach or changing records. They do not implement server-side permission enforcement.

faq.question: How far back can the channel scoreboard report?
faq.answer: It defaults to 24 hours and reaches back up to 31 days. Longer periods require a report through ask_revnu.

faq.question: Can it report pipeline and revenue?
faq.answer: It can request read-only CRM reports through ask_revnu when supported connections provide evidence. The channel scoreboard is not a general CRM ledger.

faq.question: What does an unavailable channel mean?
faq.answer: Its results are unknown. The skill should explain the returned reason rather than report zero activity.

faq.question: Does an empty approval queue mean all work is finished?
faq.answer: No. It means nothing is currently waiting in that queue. Agent status and workflow outcomes provide separate evidence about ongoing work.
